test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
There are five books kept one over the other. Two books are of English language, two books are of Management, and one book is of Statistic. Top shelf numbered as 1 and the lowest as 5. One book of Management is in the top shelf and other one is in the last shelf. Book of Statistic is kept just above English language book. One book of English is kept just above Management book. English books are kept adjacent to each other.

Which book is kept in second shelf?
solution: Arranging them according to the given information, One book of Management is in the top shelf and other one is in the last shelf. One book of English is kept just above Management book. Number Book 1 Management 2
